title: How To Delete The Avatar Preset I Created?
content:
Question 1) How To Delete The Avatar Preset I Created?

I could not find any delete button on the avatar editor?

Question 2) How can I get out from this screen in Avatar Editor?

[https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/f4f1tvnsqbza6dsrufj1s/Screenshot-2025-08-14-at-16.20.54.png?rlkey=samysslnhzhwicq3e4b7joezt&st=qj0e6lw3&dl=0](https://www.dropbox.com/scl/fi/f4f1tvnsqbza6dsrufj1s/Screenshot-2025-08-14-at-16.20.54.png?rlkey=samysslnhzhwicq3e4b7joezt&st=qj0e6lw3&dl=0)


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: To close the Avatar Editor, click the X in the top right. What do you mean by preset? If you want to reset the avatar to default measurements, in the window you have screenshot, you first have to leave the editing mask for additional measurements (1). Afterwards, you can reset the measurements with the circled button (2).
content_description: This webpage provides guidance on how to delete an avatar preset and navigate out of the avatar editor screen.

title: LOGO DISPLAY ISSUE IN 3D TAB
content:
![c42c537d41a5455ea8e58db76dbf243e](https://storagefiles.clo-set.com/public/community/202508/edba58eaead0408d8368b5446faceebf/images/c42c537d41a5455ea8e58db76dbf243eScreenshot%202025-08-09%20125212.jpg)when i download that file from closet connect offical and open in clo 3d the logo is showing in 2d tab in pattern but not showing in 3d tab ? can some one tell me how logo show in t-shirt in 3d tab 


### Community Post Comments:
Comment 1: Hellow - Check Placement:Click on Graphic , On the Property editor , Graphic Configuration you will see FACE . Be sure put it in FRONT Sometimes it’s on the wrong side of the fabric and you just can’t see it in 3D.- Opacity Issue:Select the fabric where the graphic is applied → In Property Editor, check Texture Map slots. If the fabric has an Opacity Map or Graphic Opacity set to 0%, the logo will be invisible in 3D.And know that sometimes when you download an asset from CLO-SET, sometimes the graphic isn’t embedded—it’s just a reference link. Right-click the graphic → Change Graphic → Re-import the image file manually.

Comment 2: Hi There. Looks like you may have installed an unofficial version of CLO. We would first recommend subscribing and downloading CLO directly from our website. This will likely solve many issues and allow you to update to CLO 2025
content_description: This webpage aims to provide guidance on how to properly display a logo on a t-shirt in 3D within CLO 3D after downloading it from Closet Connect.
